MeterRoot.description: The meter: a `<div>` with `role="meter"` and the value, range and value text as ARIA attributes. It shares the clamped value, its percentage and the formatted text with the parts inside it, through the `meter` context.

props.value: The measured value. A value outside the range is clamped to it; one that isn't a number reads as `min`.
props.min: The lowest value of the range.
props.max: The highest value of the range.
props.format: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for showing and announcing the value. With them the clamped value is formatted; without, its percentage of the range.
props.locale: The locale the value is formatted in. The browser's locale when left out.
props.getAriaValueText: Returns the text announced for the meter, from the formatted value and the raw one. The formatted value is used when it is left out.

MeterTrack.description: The bar the indicator fills. It has no behaviour: give it a height and a background.

MeterIndicator.description: The filled part of the track. Its inline style sets `width` to the value's share of the range, `height: inherit` and `inset-inline-start: 0`.

MeterValue.description: The formatted value as text. It is hidden from assistive technology, since the root announces the value. For other text, spread `meterValue()` on an element of your own and read the `meter` context.

MeterLabel.description: Names the meter: the root's `aria-labelledby` points at it. Pass an `id` to use your own; one is generated otherwise.
